examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}のことが{心配|しんぱい}だ。

notes:
{娘|むすめ} means daughter (family relationship) or a young woman/girl.

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Daughter: one's female child
2. Girl/young woman: unmarried young female (somewhat old-fashioned)

FAMILY TERMS:
- {息子|むすこ}: son
- {娘|むすめ}: daughter
- お{嬢|じょう}さん: daughter (polite), young lady

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {娘|むすめ}さん: (your) daughter (polite)
- {一人娘|ひとりむすめ}: only daughter
- {娘婿|むすめむこ}: son-in-law
- {箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}: sheltered daughter

USAGE NOTE:
When referring to someone else's daughter politely, use {娘|むすめ}さん or お{嬢|じょう}さん. The second meaning (young woman) is less common in modern speech.
